implementationStatus: Design only. These semantics must be implemented and compiled against the actual datasource in later scopes.

literalSemantics.comparison: ordinal code-unit comparison; no culture-sensitive comparison or normalization
literalSemantics.selection: for one pattern, emit the leftmost match and continue after its end; matches that overlap the selected match are not emitted
literalSemantics.crossPatternSelection: each labeled pattern is searched independently; a match from one pattern never suppresses an overlapping match from another
literalSemantics.equalPatternText: distinct PatternId values remain distinct logical patterns
literalSemantics.emptyPattern: reject as invalid input before opening the root
literalSemantics.metacharacters: ordinary text in literal mode, including regex metacharacters

regexSemantics.selection: earliest start wins; alternatives beginning at the same position use source order (leftmost-first), not leftmost-longest
allowedFeatures: start/end record anchors and word boundaries
rejectedFeatures: any construct unsupported by the selected non-backtracking profile
regexSemantics.unsupportedBehavior: reject the request with a typed unsupported-pattern result; never silently retry with a backtracking engine, literal mode or another dialect
regexSemantics.invalidBehavior: reject malformed syntax before opening the root

zeroWidthSemantics.progress: after emitting a zero-width match, advance the search start by one Unicode scalar when not already at the end of the record
zeroWidthSemantics.endOfRecord: an end-position zero-width match is emitted at most once
zeroWidthSemantics.emptyRecord: an empty physical record is a valid record; an empty file has no physical records unless a later line contract says otherwise

wholeWordSemantics.boundary: a whole-word match starts or ends at a record boundary or where word status changes

encodingSemantics.auto: honor a supported BOM; otherwise interpret as UTF-8
encodingSemantics.explicit: the declared mode must agree with a present BOM and input decoding
encodingSemantics.invalidBytes: typed failure; replacement characters are not a successful fallback
encodingSemantics.byteCoordinates: always measured in original input bytes
encodingSemantics.bytesSource: raw byte matching is handled by search.bytes and is not converted into text regex semantics

ordering.withinPattern: increasing source start, then increasing end for a same-start tie
ordering.manySameStart: input pattern order is the deterministic tie-breaker after path and byte start
ordering.sql: source order is not an SQL ordering guarantee; callers need ORDER BY for a promised result order

truthTables.purpose: Separate within-pattern non-overlap from cross-pattern independence and regex alternative order.

cases.name: single-pattern-overlap
cases.rule: the suffix-starting match at 2 overlaps the selected match at 0 and is not emitted

cases.name: cross-pattern-prefix
cases.rule: overlap across independent pattern IDs is retained

cases.name: regex-alternative-order
cases.rule: same-start alternatives use source order, not longest-match selection

truthTables.purpose: Keep pattern labels as stable row identity.
Prevent an unbounded stream of empty literal rows.
Make record anchors independent of backend file-buffer behavior.
Emit useful zero-width matches while guaranteeing progress.
Use explicit Unicode word status without normalization or culture drift.

cases.name: composed-word
cases.rule: composed and decomposed text are not normalized into one form

cases.name: decomposed-word
cases.rule: the combining mark remains part of the Unicode word

cases.name: combining-mark-does-not-create-boundary
cases.rule: a combining mark after the match is word-like, so cafe is not a whole word
